scope: Correct only the V17 standalone CPU feasibility diagnostic's provenance eligibility. Existing semantic batch/finalOwnershipToken plus track, arcSegmentId and exact primitive define eligibility. Frozen contrast-probe IDs and repair IDs are post-generation regression/matcher inputs only. This gate does not determine feasibility and does not authorize implementation, production, CMake, GPU, readiness, capture or acceptance.

root_correction_binding.statement: ROOT CORRECTION DECISION: V17 intersection eligibility provenance is existing semantic batch/finalOwnershipToken + track + arcSegmentId + exact primitive; contrast probe IDs are post-generation regression only.

supersession.superseded_reason: Its existing_source_probe_id descriptor field was implemented as an eligibility requirement, allowing the sparse contrast-probe inventory to reject valid semantic draw descriptors before analytic intersection testing.
still_preserved_from_superseded_gate: strict unique interior nonparallel predicted dash-on predicate
exact 81 contrast-probe IDs/digest and three repair IDs as post-generation regression
no source, token, semantic batch or product geometry growth
no production, CMake, GPU, readiness, capture or acceptance authorization

sparse_probe_failure_finding.valid_conclusion: Sparse contrast probes were incorrectly promoted to descriptor eligibility, so the zero-event result cannot prove geometric infeasibility.
sparse_probe_failure_finding.invalid_conclusion: The frozen broadcast geometry contains zero strict intersections.

corrected_eligibility_provenance_contrac.source_of_truth: The exact existing semantic draw batch covering the descriptor, not the sparse contrast-probe inventory.
required_identity_fields: existing nonzero finalOwnershipToken identical across the batch vertices
corrected_eligibility_provenance_contrac.actual_role: Exact existing ActualRouteBodyCore semantic batch and exact primitive; endpoints, ticks, markers and halos are ineligible.
corrected_eligibility_provenance_contrac.predicted_role: Exact existing predicted base core dash-on body semantic batch and exact primitive; cap extension, dash gap, halos, endpoint, tick and marker are ineligible.
corrected_eligibility_provenance_contrac.normalized_stem_use: Event deduplication only; it must never associate a descriptor to a semantic batch, finalOwnershipToken, contrast probe, primitive or arc.
corrected_eligibility_provenance_contrac.event_key: ordered(existing actual finalOwnershipToken, actual track, actual arcSegmentId, actual exact primitiveId, existing predicted finalOwnershipToken, predicted track, predicted arcSegmentId, predicted exact primitiveId, predicted normalized stem for dedupe, analytic route-order/dash ordinal)

permitted_uses: after the complete coordinate-free event inventory and its digest are frozen, verify exact 81 probe order and digest did not drift
after generation, match the three repair IDs/regions to events for acceptance reporting
after generation, compare standard/CVD and 1x/2x/4x regression outputs
forbidden_uses: intersection generation, classification, selection or deduplication

preserved_feasibility_contract.predicate: Exactly one strict interior, robustly nonparallel ActualRouteBodyCore segment by predicted base-core dash-on-body segment event per repair region; collinear, parallel, tangent, endpoint, ambiguous, dash-gap, cap, halo, marker or unowned cases fail closed.

required_fail_closed_fixtures: contrast probe absent while exact semantic batch/token/track/arc/exact primitive exists remains eligible
contrast probe present without matching exact semantic batch identity remains ineligible
normalized-stem core/halo cannot substitute for exact primitive source association
same analytic event across samples dedupes by normalized stem only after exact source association
missing, zero, mixed or foreign finalOwnershipToken fails closed
coordinates, repair IDs, contrast probes, palette and prior result cannot alter generated full-frame inventory
strict interior nonparallel positive and collinear/parallel/tangent/endpoint/dash-gap/cap/halo negatives
zero or multiple qualifying events at any repair matcher forces infeasible
exact 81 contrast-probe order/digest and three repair IDs checked only after generation
production and CMake hashes remain exact baselines
no semantic batch, token, source probe, primitive or arc inventory growth
